reviews.review_description: The initial process of our installation was excellent. Graham came and quoted everything and was happy to answer questions. We went ahead with the installation and everything was great. The only let down in my opinion was the lack of information post installation.  We didn't know that we had to wait up to 4 weeks for an inspector to come and switch it on. We didn't know what the process was to get our supplier to change our supply to feed in tarrif. So when I asked these questions I got defensive responses. I felt that it would have been good of them to provide some written information on what the post installation steps were then I would of had to continue to ask questions.  Other than that we are very happy with how it all went.

Graham from Greenlink solar was great in explaining our solar system requirements and matched a very competitive price from another solar provider. The installation was quick and profesional under trying times (Bad weather on and off) and our 15kw 3 phase solar system with Sungrove inverter was completed within 2 days.Highly recomend Greenlink Solar.
Installation was prompt and professional. Green link Organised connection. Great price
Greenlink solar owner came to our house. They assessed our shade situation and suggested optimisers. Reasonable price, smaller company, good service.

Greenlink Solar were just fantastic. Super considerate, friendly and took great pride in doing an excellent job. I'd have no hesitation in recommending Greenlink to my family and friends.Greenlink is a family business and the only installers that offered to come out to our house to look at what would work best, discuss layout and understand our needs on a much more detailed level. This put Greenlink way ahead on customer service, and while the other quotes I received were from friendly people, their proposals were just done from Near Maps and very much standard installs that really did not need my needs and not even close to what Greenlink put together.The Installer were great, very thoughtful, and made sure they had everything just right. They left our shed and garage cleaner than when they started.All grid connection, paperwork etc was done by Greenlink so I basically did not need to do a thing.GreenLink were not the cheapest quote but the quality of equipment they provided and the quality of the install was definitely premium compared to many others I have seenOverall I am really happy with the system we have ended up with. it's future proof, well researched and high quality. Thanks to Graham and his team.

Graham and the team were very professional and friendly. They didn’t push for the sale and they patiently answered all of my questions. I would definitely call them again in the future as well as recommend them to anyone who needs a solar system.
An informative first visit by Graham Smith with full information. Very helpful throughout the whole process. We are very happy with the outcome.
The best company to work with and great work by all thx.

The guys from GreenLink were responsive and on time. Quotes came in within days and any follow up questions answered straight away. Site inspection helped sort out any particulars. Install was quick and the team cleaned up afterwards. Apart from the shiny new solar panels you wouldn't know that had been here. looking forward to saving.

After taking with the owner Graham who spend plenty of time going through and helping me understand how the system works and options on offer.Installation time and date was set the installers arrived right on time and were very well mannered and polite.After completing the install Dylan spend time explaining the system and how to use it correctly.Site was left spotless swept and cleaned.Install is of a very high standard very neat and looks spot on.I would highly recommend Greenlink Solar to install your solar system.

Greenlink Solar we’re quick & informatively helpful when replying to emails. The installer was professional & punctual. They were respectful of our property & did a smart job on the installation of the pv panels and inverter

First Contact through Solar Quotes - Easy to deal with.Install Guys were experienced and professional.Equipment looks good (especially the Black frame on the Solar Panels).Too early to tell about, performance & reliability, but promising.Paperwork was simple and well guided, No issues.

Put my details into solar quotes over the weekend. Greenlink solar were the first to contact me and the ONLY company who bothered to come out for a face to face consultation. The other two recommended companies took up to a week to get in touch; one had a pushy salesperson and the other was very expensive and didn't bother following up. For these reasons, I was chose to go with Greenlink Solar. Installation day was great, they turned up right on time and explained everything before leaving. I am satisfied with the entire experience and definitely feel I made the right choice.

Very pleased with my set up.Graham and Cheryl were terrific through-out the whole process.Their advice on what was required (and what wasn't) to best suit our needs, was easy to understand.Installation was delayed a week, due to the Covid 19, but was worth waiting for.Graham and Cheryl personally delivered all the gear the day before installation.The team arrived punctually the next morning and got straight into it.Very friendly, polite and extremely tidy.It was all completed on the same day.20 Jinko panels, set up in two very neat lines of 10, on North facing colorbond roof.Fronius Inverter very neatly placed on inside of garage wall, back to back with power meter.Fronius Smart meter situated in meter box looks very neat and tidy.All in all, a very neat and professional job. Very easy on the eye.I had a minor hiccup connecting to the SolarWeb App , but Graham promptly got me sorted out.I strongly recommend GreenLink Solar for friendly service and professional results
Good sales quoting. Good installation very punctual & professional. Installed on Thursday onto grid on Tuesday 15/9/20. The checker was done on Tuesday.More to find out when they inform company.

Greenlink Solar made the process of getting solar super easy.Graham & Cheryl had excellent response time & were very informative, knowledgeable and a super friendly professional company to deal with.We had complete support throughout the whole process, starting with great advice and getting a good understanding of which was the best solar system for us.They made it so simple to step through the process and navigate our way from the paperwork to the solar panel installation.The installers were very punctual, polite and super tidy, our solar panels look fantastic and the invertor was fitted very neatly. They also organised the grid connection after the install, leaving us feeling very confident and comfortable that everything was done with no stress to us.We would highly recommend Greenlink Solar to anyone thinking of going down the solar path, you won't find a better or more supportive company to deal with from start to finish.Thanks for a easy conversion to solar,Bill & Susy
Fantastic people. Good communication throughout the process   I’d recommend them to my friends.
Straitfoword easy going did grid connection. Showed me how to use it. Took about 4 00 to do the whole job.

The project started very well. But come installation time, it spiralled downward very quickly. The first installation came around and the installers arrived. What followed was a standoff between the installers - and our family was witness to a barrage of expletives. The team refused to do the installation due to what we believe was simply because our roof was terracotta tiles.This was on top of installation date delays due to equipment availability. Some weeks later, a sub-contracted installation team arrived. They started the job promptly, but missed a day or so where they just didn't turn up to complete the job on consecutive days. In the process of installation there were in excess of 30 tiles broken. Fortunately we had many spares.In the year following installation, we discovered further tiles broken, including the ridge capping, and this has caused a roof leak that had been leaking into our newly constructed living area (as part of a home extension less than a year old at the time). This has caused ceiling damage. We are now fighting to have the roof repaired to a satisfactory condition (multiple tubes of clear silicon on a black roof is not acceptable), along with replastering and repainting. They seem to think it is our responsibility to contact the sub-contracted installers, however we paid and have an agreement with Greenlink Solar, not the sub-contractors. It has now been seven weeks since we brought this to their attention, and as we get no response to emails and nothing has yet been organised, we are now escalating this matter with both Consumer Affairs and also the Clean Energy Council.This is most disappointing as until recently (and despite the installation problems) we had referred many others to Greenlink Solar, however their post-sales service and communication leaves a lot to be desired.
very easyvery tidy, and politecustomer service was 5 star

I did lots of research on solar energy, the installation process, costs and maintenance before even reaching out for a quote. I also put the feelers out on social media to see which businesses came recommended and which didn't.Greenlink Solar was recommended by this group (Solar Quotes) and I decided to proceed the quoting process with Greenlink Solar and six other competitors. There are SO many competitors!!I chose Graham in the end thanks to his friendly nature, knowledge and advice on solar energy. I never felt like I was being pushed to go with his business as I was honest about talking to other installers. It ultimately came down to who I felt safe with, who wasn't trying to sell me their business, but who was passionate about solar energy.The installation day was memorable. Dylan, Graham's son, managed the whole project/day and he was equally as friendly as his Dad! So were his co-workers. There was minimal disruption to us throughout the day - and all the boys working at our home seemed to have a good work ethic.We found it challenging to setup the monitoring of our inverter so we called Greenlink for help and their son Jackson was onto it within only a few days. We were pretty impressed! We've had no concerns or issues since our install and we enjoyed looking at our conversion rates throughout January.The whole family is just lovely and I want to thank Cheryl, Graham, Dylan and Jackson (and the rest of the boys who came out) one last time. Thank you!

The process from start to finish was seamless, although there was a delay due to Covid19 restrictions.Graham, Sheryl were very professional, patience and helpful from the very beginning with my enquiries as I was new to the whole solar thing. Graham took his time to answer my questions promptly, and offered a competitive pricing...but at the end it was he service and a feeling of trust that cement my decision to go with Solar Link. Better than a few other installers, that didn't have the patience, time or interest of helping you.....We ended up on installing 2 systems, 8.2KW (LG Neon2  360W) on my property and 6.6KW (Longi  370W) on my parent's.All with Fronius inverter.On installation, Dylan and his team were very punctual, friendly and efficient. They cleaned and tidy up after their work.The installation are neat and professional.I would highly recommend Solar Link for everyone interested in Solar installation.Both systems are working perfectly and generating great output so far.....looking forward to my next bill cycle on the saving.....

While all three solar retailers that I spoke to were very informative and friendly, Graham at Greenlink Solar also took the time to visit and inspect our property and designed a system that made good use of our roof, was cost effective and efficient.Communication with Graham and Cheryl at Greenlink Solar was great - they always got back to us so promptly and answered all our questions so we felt very confident to proceed with the installation.Apart from the price, which was very competitive in comparison to other quotes we received, another deciding factor was that Greenlink Solar offered an in-house finance solution, rather than a third party option and this will save us a lot of money in the long run.The contract signing process and setup for the Government rebates was made quick and easy by Cheryl. Installation was handled by their son, Dylan and team, who were all friendly and polite. They got the panels up in half a day and they look amazing. The Inverter box was installed neatly and discretely in one corner of the house.Overall, we were very pleased with the service provided by this local family business and cannot recommend highly enough!
Prompt service, answered all my questions, had a quick installation with no issues.

It was to much of my suprise when starting to look into Solar and getting quotes/ideas about what to get, that I quickly learnt how very 'Used Car Salesmen' the process is and how forced or awful some of the companies out there are.With Greenlink Solar I had NONE of those issues at all, after speaking with Graham on the phone and talking to him about what I was trying to achieve with the solar I knew Greenlink were going to my pick. Graham happily went through what I was after and added his professional inputs and suggestions without the conversation every feeling forced.After selecting to go ahead with Greenlink we were in the midst of stage 4 lockdown in Victoria and the communication of what, when and how from the team were great keeping everyone informed of progress and re-starting.On installation day Dylan the installer with his team were extremely clean, punctuate and very informative about the process, what happens and how it all works. I also on the day wanted to see if it was possible to change up the array slightly and how it was positioned on the roof and the team had ZERO issues with accommodating my request and sorting it out for me.Overall the entire process was seamless, easy and smooth. If ever change, upgrade or require new solar again I will be using Greenlink and have already recommended them to friends.
Greenlink solar were fantastic to deal with. From coming out to quote, through to installation, and after sales service the process was seamless.Very happy and would definitely recommend.

The main admin staff were friendly and helpful and my property was inspected prior to installation.Installation was super efficient and the technicians /electricians were polite and informative at all times.Very happy with entire process..thank you Greenlink...sincerely

I had initially sought a quote from another company, before using the SolarQuotes request a quote process.Graham from GreenLink Solar emailed me and advised he could visit my property the next day at 11am. A couple more emails, and Graham's visit was booked in. This is in contrast to the first company who quoted me, without a site visit or even suggestion that site visit would be important.Graham arrived at my house as scheduled, and was very helpful in person. Graham was clearly experienced in working with the varying level of knowledge customers had, and not overdoing or underdoing the technical information he shared. Graham's site visit turned out to be essential, as it confirmed my suspicion that I would need panels over two roof orientations, and the system would need to be designed to accommodate this.Graham initially designed a system using specific premium brand components. This came in above my budget. Graham was able to discuss a range of other options, and also did so by email - a big plus for me, as I can't take phone calls easily during the work day. Through email over the next few days, we worked out a suitable system that would match my budget, take into account the ability to overspec the number of panels within the approved limits, and cater to my desire for a Fronius inverter.All systems were go for me to apply for the Victorian Solar Rebate. Unfortunately I was left in a bit of a panic on the day that rebates opened at 12pm, as Cheryl had made a typo in her email to me with the required quote number, and I had not received the email. This was resolved before 12pm with a phone call to Cheryl.Rebate was successfully acquired! Install date was delayed due to a lack of Fronius inverters in the country. Graham kept me up to date by email, and in the end was able to schedule an install date sooner than first expected. Graham did offer an alternative SMA inverter to speed things up, however my own research showed the current SMA inverters were made in China - I was happy to wait for the Fronius.Graham was in touch in the days prior to the install, the weather wasn't looking fantastic. In the end, the installation crew of three arrived at my house just before 8am on the allotted day. Despite intermittent patches of rain, the install crew did what they were able to do, and certainly didn't down tools! There was a slight hiccup where the location for the inverter had changed from the original design, and notice of this hadn't been passed through to the installation crew. When I noticed them setting up tools in the wrong spot, I let them know, and they were able to change tack and install the inverter in the garage, as the external brick wall receives direct sunlight.The install crew worked hard and did a great job, and waited out the adverse weather conditions that might have seen others packing up. Since install, the system has been working very well, I am just now waiting for the cogs of bureaucracy to turn for it to be approved and have the Feed in Tariff applied.I would happily recommend GreenLink Solar to my friends and family!

I would recommend greenlink solar without hesitation, from start to finish the services was without fault, all our questions were answered and nothing was to much trouble.
